resources.string: The sync server refuses the plans
Sync files not written – storage full?
Your saved plans and imported GPX tracks can also be in the web planner on your computer – both ways, encrypted on the device before they leave it.
On the computer, open plan.onpath.earth and click “Pair phone” at the top. Scan the code shown there with your phone's camera – OnPath opens and shows six check digits.
No camera app found – open the camera yourself and scan the code.
On your computer open plan.onpath.earth → ‘Pair phone’ and scan the code
Check: %1$s – the browser shows the same six digits.
Paired. What you save in the browser comes to your phone – everything is kept there.
Plans stop syncing. They stay on this phone and in the browser.
Unpaired. Your plans stay on your phone.
Unpaired. Your plans stay on your phone – the browser couldn't be reached, unpair it there too.
The pairing was ended in the browser. Your plans stay on this phone.
Offline – your plans sync when the connection is back.
The sync server did not accept the plans (%1$s). Try again later.
The browser sync is full – delete some plans or tracks, then try again.
